predictive_handover.title: Predictive Inter-gNB / Beam Handover
predictive_handover.description: Pre-synchronizes UE context with candidate target gNB before Radio Link Failure (RLF) occurs, preventing packet drops during high mobility.

dynamic_prb_reservation.title: Dynamic Physical Resource Block (PRB) Reservation
dynamic_prb_reservation.description: Proactively allocates higher spectrum slices or priority PRBs in the MAC scheduler to maintain continuous bitrates for mission-critical slices.

adaptive_abr_video.title: Proactive ABR / DASH Bitrate Adaptation
adaptive_abr_video.description: Signals the Edge MEC video transcoder or DASH client to request lower-bitrate video segments in advance, eliminating buffer stall events.

dual_connectivity_steering.title: Dual Connectivity (EN-DC / NR-DC) Traffic Steering
dual_connectivity_steering.description: Switches secondary cell group (SCG) transmission legs or activates dual-connectivity bearer before primary cell link quality collapses.

tradeoff_synthesis.short_horizon_1s: High accuracy (F1 > 0.85, low RMSE), ideal for predictive beam tracking and fast MAC-layer PRB scheduling, but limited time for inter-gNB handovers.
tradeoff_synthesis.medium_horizon_3_5s: Balanced trade-off (F1 ~ 0.75-0.80), provides sufficient lead time for MEC video stream adaptation (ABR/DASH) and seamless target gNB preparation.
tradeoff_synthesis.long_horizon_10_15s: Lower precision due to rapid wireless channel fading and unpredictable mobility changes, but enables strategic dual-connectivity steering and core network slice re-routing.
